subject: Performance remediation plan for Ethan Park — legal/HR review
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed performance remediation for Ethan Park — need template and legal signoff

Team —

I need HR + Legal input on starting a formal remediation process for Ethan Park (Eng, Platform). Over the last two quarters we've documented multiple missed milestones, repeated missed sprint commitments, and a couple of high-severity customer incidents where his PRs introduced regressions that took >24 hours to fix. I want to proceed with a timeboxed improvement plan but want to make sure the language, timeline, and escalation steps are legally sound before I talk to Ethan.

Quick asks: 
- Can HR share the current PIP template we use (manager-facing) and any recent edits?
- Legal: any mandatory phrasing we must include/avoid, and suggested remediation duration (6 vs 8 weeks)?
- Is there anything to flag re: accommodation process or performance documentation sufficiency?

I've attached a short summary (will send evidence bundle separately once I sanitize notes). My preference is a 6-week plan with weekly check-ins and clear success criteria. If we move forward, I'd like to schedule the initial conversation next week (Nov 25 or 26).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed performance remediation for Ethan Park — need template and legal signoff

Thanks for the heads up, Kim. Attached is the most recent manager-facing PIP template (draft_pip_template_v2.docx) — we updated the success criteria section earlier this year. A few immediate notes:

- HR prefers a 6-week timeboxed plan for ICs unless there are complicating accommodations.
- Please ensure each performance example is dated and includes impact (bug/regression, customer impact, time to recover).
- For the initial meeting, HR should be present as a neutral note-taker; we typically recommend Manager + HR (no Legal required at the first conversation unless there are active legal issues).

If you can send the evidence bundle (redacted), I will slot a 30-min intake with you on Monday 11/23 to finalize wording.

Best,
Laura Bennett
People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed performance remediation for Ethan Park — legal/HR review needed

Appreciate the flag. A few legal points to consider as you prepare the document and evidence: 

1) Avoid speculative language ("seems to be" / "appears to") — stick to observable facts with dates and impact.
2) If Ethan has any active accommodation requests or protected leave recently, escalate to Legal immediately — do you know of any?
3) Verify that progressive coaching was documented (1:1 notes, prior performance conversations). If not, we can still proceed but we need to be cautious in how we phrase potential outcomes.
4) On duration: 6 weeks is defensible; 8 weeks can be requested if the role has complex ramp metrics, but HR should own that decision.

Please attach the evidence set and the draft PIP language you intend to read to Ethan; I'll review for any phrasing that could imply punitive intent beyond remediation.

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Employment
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed performance remediation for Ethan Park — evidence attached and proposed meeting times

Team — attaching the evidence bundle (supporting_examples.zip) with: dated sprint notes, customer incident tickets, PR review threads, and 1:1 notes. I redacted personal notes that aren’t factual.

Draft language below (short version I intend to read):
"Ethan, over the last six months we've observed missed commitments on the Platform team that have led to delayed deliverables and two customer-facing regressions (Ticket #4521, #4890) where rollbacks were required. The goal of this improvement plan is to provide focused objectives, weekly coaching, and a clear set of success criteria. If the objectives are not met within the six-week period, we'll need to discuss next steps up to and including role reassignment."

Questions I want to confirm before we send the invite to Ethan:
- Is the wording above acceptable to Legal? Any suggested edits?
- HR: is 6 weeks okay given the artifacts?
- Proposed meeting windows for the initial conversation: Wed 11/25 10:00–10:30 AM PST, Thu 11/26 2:00–2:30 PM PST.

I'll join an intake call Monday 11/23 to walk through the packet if that helps.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
